facts.scope_summary: Implement Google's Silicon Customer Owned Tooling (COT) supply chain across SAP S/4HANA, Kinaxis, and E2Open to move from black-box operations to end-to-end manufacturing traceability, partner collaboration, and yield-aware planning. Scope includes phased delivery of manufacturing visibility, business go-live, expanded scope, integrations, procurement/logistics processes, and organizational change management for the Silicon business.

out_of_scope: CO/FICO configuration owned by Google internal team — out of Bristlecone scope
Material valuation, costing, yield accounting, TMS, EWM and Commercial Invoice APIs are either handled by Corp Eng/ASCII or are completely out of scope for Bristlecone

assumptions: Material valuation, costing, yield accounting, TMS, EWM and Commercial Invoice APIs are either handled by Corp Eng/ASCII or are completely out of scope for Bristlecone.
BOM explosion owned by PLM sharing GPNs/BOMs with CM partners can largely be leveraged from present instance SAP and Kinaxis consumes.
TSMC PO capability must be live by Dec 4 — hard deadline; 22-week fab runway bounds upstream readiness.
Google owns WIP after probe completion at TSMC only — not before; ownership transfers at goods receipt; Google to confirm.
All Phase 1 and Phase 2 manufacturing steps occur within Taiwan — no international mid-stream flows until Phase 3.
Inventory POs issued to TSMC and UMTC for wafer and substrate procurement; subcontracting POs issued to OSATs for all transformation steps.
Silicon Data Hub is system of record for unit-level test data and yield inputs into Kinaxis.
Manufacturing strategy is Make-to-Stock through die bank and Make-to-Order from die bank to finished goods.
Lot genealogy and yield capture will reside in E2Open and the Silicon Data Hub, not SAP.
UMTC substrate has an 18-week lead time and a substrate PO may need to be cut before Kinaxis is live.
Kinaxis workbooks shall be recreated on a new instance with existing references.
Yield and MLS functionalities shall be a new configuration.
Preferred to retain Google’s existing integration framework used for machine planning.
Existing integration will be leveraged and incremental delta interface will be in scope, subject to discovery analysis.
Subcontracting PO model: Google issues components to OSAT, OSAT transforms, Google receives finished part.
Schedule agreements for high-volume/rolling TSMC wafer orders — not individual POs.
B-parts and C-parts tracked separately.
EDI for existing partners; B2B/file-based or manual for others.
Google-owned tooling must be capitalized with depreciation tracked.
All Phase 1/2 manufacturing moves are within Taiwan and managed via Google Cloud Logistics for intra-Taiwan moves.
Quanta acts as exporter of record for finished goods shipped from Taiwan to Google USA.
Google becomes importer of record for finished goods entering the USA under COT.
GPlan is the primary middleware integrating PLM, SAP, and Kinaxis.
Integration between PLM to S/4HANA and Kinaxis to S/4 will be done through existing GPLAN/SAL API framework and Google internal team will configure.
